description:
£125 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to present this three bedroom student flat, ideally located in the popular area of Sandyford, just a short walk from Newcastle City Centre and both Newcastle and Northumbria Universities.

Neutrally decorated throughout, the property features an open-plan living area with a modern fitted kitchen, three well-proportioned double bedrooms, each furnished with a desk, and a bathroom with a shower over the bath.

The property also benefits from a private rear yard, providing additional outdoor space. Offering excellent value for money in a convenient location, early viewing is highly recommended to avoid disappointment.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team.
